column4: Subject 'he' dropped; Japanese reads as first person (I was knocked about), changing who the sentence is about.
column5: He got knocked about a bit as a kid, so he doesn't trust people easily.
column6: 子どものころ少し暴力を受けていたので、なかなか人を信用しません。
column7: I was knocked around a bit as a kid, so I have a hard time trusting people.
